svg.title: ScienceEvolve · Resume the simulation workflow.
svg.desc: Materials structure relaxation: System Runtime detects an interrupted Executor session, retains completed Plan and Coder steps, restores the Agent session, and continues Review and results.csv delivery. This is Agent session recovery, not an external simulation checkpoint claim. Agent cards label their Harness: Codex, DSH or pi, preserving the depicted configuration across recovery and intentional version changes.
